Highway Song

March 24, 2006
Each passing day is so fucked up in it’s own way, that I often wonder, “How can my life be ever monotonous!” : sigh.. Just another bad day. Would be glad to crawl through.

Song of the year :: HighwaySong by Blackfoot.
Last 2min 35sec of guitar takes the cake away!! Mind blowing. Simply, Mind Blowing.
Can’t believe I missed this one for last 6 years! :)

Missing you badly. Couldn’t sleep last night, was just listening to this song, again and again… says a lot to me.
Hope you are doing great!
Love ya..
